votes.motion: Direct Superintendent Holman to develop and design specs for the handicap access railing and walkway from the Mass Office of Disabilities for the North Cemetery Receiving Tomb ramp.

decisions.decision: The Commission accepted Superintendent Holman's draft of the Town Report as amended; Commissioner Tyler will send it to the Selectman's office.
decisions.quote: superintendent holman submitted his draft of the town report to the commission and it was accepted as amended.

decisions.decision: Chairman May informed the Charter Review Committee representative that the charter wording needed to add the word "sole" to Section 3-5 line b, powers and duties.
decisions.quote: the wording in the charter needed to be amended to add the word "sole" to section 3-5- line b, powers and duties.

decisions.decision: Amending the Rules and Regulations was to be discussed further at the March meeting.
decisions.quote: lastly amending rules and regulations was discussed, and it was decided to discuss further at our march meeting.
